about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV8 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport TDV8 has been a part of the range since 2005, offering a powerful and refined V8 diesel option across two generations. Early models (L320, 2005–2013) were fitted with the TDV8, while the later L494 generation (2013–2022) received the more powerful SDV8. While both are 4.4-litre V8 diesel units, the SDV8 represents a later evolution with different output and tuning. Range Rover Sport TDV8 Engine Codes TDV8 (L320) A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Sport from 2005 to 2013. This engine is known for a well-documented pattern of timing chain wear and injector seal leaks. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 rebuild. Check Your TDV8 Range Rover Sport → [link to quote form] SDV8 (L494) A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Sport from 2013 to 2022. A later iteration of the V8 diesel, it shares the same pattern of timing chain wear and injector seal leaks as its predecessor. We service it to the same standard as the TDV8. Check Your SDV8 Range Rover Sport → [link to quote form] Range Rover Sport TDV8 Engine Compatibility Because the Range Rover Sport TDV8 spans two similar but distinct engines across two generations, it's crucial to confirm your exact engine code before starting any work. We verify: - Your exact engine code (TDV8 or SDV8) via registration or VIN - Your generation (L320 or L494) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual vehicle. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes. Related Land Rover Range Rover Sport Variants Looking for a different Range Rover Sport engine? We also cover: [Range Rover Sport TDV6 Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport SDV6 Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport SDV8 Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport HSE Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport SVR Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport P400 Engine →] [← View All Range Rover Sport Engines] Frequently Asked Questions What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV8 use? It depends on the year. From 2005 to 2013 (L320 generation), the Range Rover Sport TDV8 used the TDV8 4.4-litre V8 diesel. From 2013 to 2022 (L494), it switched to the SDV8 4.4-litre V8 diesel — a later, more powerful evolution of the same engine family. How much does a Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV8 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £4,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover Sport TDV8? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV8 or the SDV8 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild TDV8 Range Rover Sport engines? Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 rebuild. Do you rebuild SDV8 Range Rover Sport engines? Yes. The SDV8 is a later iteration of the V8 diesel, and we service it to the same high standard as the TDV8, addressing its common timing chain and injector wear patterns. Do you supply used Range Rover Sport TDV8 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Range Rover Sport TDV8 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Range Rover Sport TDV8 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover Sport TDV8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Sport TDV8 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
